tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: For the past thirty-five years, the Smithson Theater has brought award-winning shows to the people of Hartford. Tonight's performance of the play Love Again is no exception. If you'd like to show your support for the Smithson Theater and the work we do, please make a donation at the ticket counter after the show. Five dollars, fifty dollars, or five hundred dollars, any contribution is welcome. But for now, please sit back, relax, and enjoy the show.

Bus passes will be free to all residents for the first month. After that, the cost of a month-long pass will be just 25 dollars. For information on bus routes and schedules, log on to www.allmancc.gov. Now stay tuned for a traffic update.

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that a Canadian marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about local restaurants.

questions.question: What is your favorite local restaurant and how often do you eat there?
questions.modelAnswer: My favorite local restaurant is a family-owned Vietnamese noodle eatery, and I eat there at least once a week.

questions.question: How much do you usually spend on a meal at a local restaurant?
questions.modelAnswer: I typically spend around ten to fifteen dollars per meal when dining at a local restaurant.

questions.question: How would your habits of eating out change if restaurants became more expensive?
questions.modelAnswer: If dining out became significantly more expensive, I would prepare more home-cooked meals during weekdays and reserve restaurant visits only for special celebrations.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to questions using the information provided
My name is Cynthia Woodbridge, and | heard that two famous authors will be appearing at your store. Can you answer some of my questions about this event?
Question 8: When will Mr. Toudle's talk begin and how long will it last?
Question 9: Someone told me that the two authors will be appearing at your downtown store together. Is that true?
Question 10: What will happen after Mr.Toudle and Ms. Waits give their talk?
tasks.scheduleHtml:
Respond to questions using the information provided

My name is Cynthia Woodbridge, and | heard that two famous authors will be appearing at your store. Can you answer some of my questions about this event?

Question 8: When will Mr. Toudle's talk begin and how long will it last?

Question 9: Someone told me that the two authors will be appearing at your downtown store together. Is that true?

Question 10: What will happen after Mr.Toudle and Ms. Waits give their talk?

questions.modelAnswer: According to the provided schedule, the event is scheduled to start promptly at 9:00 A.M. in the main auditorium.
Actually, that information is not correct. The session has been rescheduled to the morning, and all participants are invited to attend.
Certainly. There are two sessions scheduled in the afternoon: first, a workshop from 1:30 to 2:45 P.M., followed by a closing discussion at 3:00 P.M.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? “People should get a pay raise every year, even if they don’t perform well”.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
